problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.

diagnosis.issue: Windows laptop cannot connect to campus Wi-Fi after password change
diagnosis.likely_cause: Cached Wi-Fi credentials using the old password, or authentication requiring the new password which may need re-verification through the campus network portal
steps: Forget the Wi-Fi network in Windows Settings > Network & Internet > Wi-Fi > Manage known networks
Reconnect to campus Wi-Fi and enter the new password when prompted
Check if a captive portal login page appears and complete the authentication process
